name: Grilled arowana
nameVi: cá hải tượng nướng muối ớt
summary: Arowana grilled with salt and chili. One account seasons it with satay over charcoal and serves green-chili salt and herbs.
origin: Củ Chi. Người Lao Động says the dish is recent there and describes the grilling.
howToEat: Season the fish with salt and satay, grill it over charcoal, and serve green-chili salt and herbs. A second account names the salt-and-chili grill.
The hour is Check on arrival.
seoDescription: Arowana grilled with salt and chili, and on one account with satay and green-chili salt.
